text: Stomatology is an important branch of medicine, mainly focusing on the diagnosis, treatment, prevention of oral and maxillofacial diseases, as well as the maintenance of oral health. It covers the physiological and pathological mechanisms of tissues and organs such as teeth, gums, jawbones, and salivary glands. This major is based on clinical medicine and combines specialized oral techniques, aiming to cultivate professional physicians with the ability to diagnose and treat oral diseases.
